name_zh: 塞韦里群有限生成定理
canonical_human_claim: Let k be an algebraically closed field and X a smooth projective algebraic surface over k. The Neron-Severi group NS(X), the group of divisors on X modulo algebraic equivalence, is a finitely generated abelian group.
domain_and_universes: Planned: an algebraically closed field k and a smooth projective two-dimensional k-scheme/variety X; exact Lean universes and scheme predicates are not yet selected.
ordered_binders: field and algebraic-closure structure on k
hypotheses: X is a smooth projective algebraic surface over k
conclusion: The divisor-class group modulo algebraic equivalence NS(X) is finitely generated as an abelian group.
excluded_scope: the Picard group Pic(X), which need not be finitely generated
numerical equivalence substituted for algebraic equivalence
the stronger finite generation theorem for every smooth projective variety
